'''Robert Selby''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 17 September 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Hell]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1258">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-21-pleasonton-ca-9-17d1258/ pleasonton-ca-9-17], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-21-pleasonton-ca-9-17d1258/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
